name: yt-dlp
minimumMacOS: 11.0 (arm64 slice; the x86_64 slice was not inspected)
signature: every Mach-O is ad-hoc signed by upstream; they must be re-signed with the release identity and hardened runtime before release (Stage C2)
binaryLicenseNote: PyInstaller bundle. Upstream's list for this macOS build names mutagen (GPL-2.0-or-later), certifi (MPL-2.0), OpenSSL, curl, curl-impersonate, BoringSSL, nghttp2, Python and others; the PyInstaller bootloader is GPL-2.0-or-later with the bootloader exception. Upstream states the combined executable is GPLv3+. The licence file in the package is upstream's all-platform list (it also names GNU Readline, libintl, libidn2, libunistring and the GCC runtime; none was found in this build's files). Legal review is still required before distribution.
javascriptRuntime: Provided by Browser Setu's own sandboxed JavaScriptCore runner (Helpers/setu-jsc, pinned by BundledJSProvider.json) through a yt-dlp plugin, using the yt_dlp_ejs solver scripts bundled in this package. No Deno or Node is bundled or required. Only YouTube's n/signature challenges use it; other sites are not expected to need it (not tested here).
verification: sha256 matches the release's SHA2-256SUMS (fetched from the same release); the GPG signature of the sums file was not verified (no gpg available when this was pinned).
unpackedSize: 124 MB universal (x86_64 + arm64); main executable arm64 slice 10.5 MB
runtimeExtraction: none: the unpackaged build has its Python framework and extensions in place; no temporary executable copies are made at run time (the single-file build unpacks Python into /tmp and macOS rejects that copy: 'Python.framework is damaged')
